messages:
alex: incident-bot paged oncall at 14:03 UTC for canary v11 rollout spike :rotating_light:
incident-bot: ALERT triggered - canary-service p99 latency > 2.5s for 5m (affected routes: /v1/generate streaming)
maria: I'm on it, grabbing dashboards. Observed p95 ~ 900ms but p99 jumped to 3.2s, streaming stalls visible in trace waterfall
sam: rolling deployment to canary v11 started 13:50 UTC, 15% traffic
jordan: can we confirm if kv-cache hitrate dropped? looks like a cache eviction spike
maria: cache evictions spiked at 13:58, node az-3 shows 90% writeback I/O, could be pressure from model memory growth
alex: paging SRE (sam) — please assess rollback
sam: joining call, running quick check: `kubectl -n canary get pods -o wide --selector=app=canary-v11`

sam: tailing logs on canary pods:
```
2026-03-15T14:02:58Z WARN kvcache evict key=slot_... latency=1200ms
2026-03-15T14:03:01Z ERROR streaming write stall duration=1800ms conn=xyz
```

tia: customer-impact: a few customers in EU region reported >10s streaming stalls (support ticket #5621), estimated 0.3% of total traffic
jordan: hypothesis: model v11 increased KV footprint due to new tokenizer behavior, causing cache thrash and increased disk swap
maria: I'm seeing increased GC & memory pressure on g4dn nodes for canary-v11
sam: mitigation plan: 1) shift 100% canary traffic off to stable v10 (rollback), 2) restart nodes in az-3, 3) throttle canary scheduler
alex: do critical rollback now, call out to infra to cordon affected nodes
sam: executing traffic shift: `redwoodctl traffic shift --from canary-v11 --to stable-v10 --percent 100 --grace 30s`
incident-bot: ACTION logged - traffic shift command issued by sam at 14:10 UTC
maria: confirmed traffic back to stable-v10, p99 dropping to 800ms after 40s
sam: rolling back image on canary group: `kubectl set image deployment/canary canary=redwood/canary:v10 --namespace=canary`
jordan: restarting kvcache pods in az-3: `k scale rc kvcache-az3 --replicas=0; sleep 10; k scale rc kvcache-az3 --replicas=3`
tia: support: notified impacted customers, offered incident status and ETA, tickets updated
alex: handing off to oncall-morning (jordan) for post-mitigation monitoring and blameless follow-up
jordan: taking handoff, will keep 2h watch and gather traces for postmortem
maria: adding timeline and initial notes to incident doc: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2419
sam: root-cause hypothesis: model v11 tokenizer change increased average KV keys per request -> cache eviction cascade -> streaming stalls under tail load
alex: next steps: replay with v11 in staging with increased cache size & quant test, add mem pressure alerts, update rollout playbook to include kv footprint check
jordan: thumbs up, will attach traces and p99 graphs to incident doc
incident-bot: INCIDENT resolved - mitigation applied at 14:12 UTC. Severity reduced to SEV2, paging cleared
maria: marking for postmortem, assigning to eng-ml and eng-runtime
alex: thanks everyone, great coordination. :thumbsup:
